static_traits.name: Li Zhuo
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but struggles to talk about incompetence and troubles at Work; relationship with colleagues becoming strained and distant due to insufficient confidence
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;without previous psychological problems or treatment history;not yet experienced similar problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, able to notice and describe negative Automatic thoughts; speech rate and logical speed Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: After giving a client computer repair advice I believe was incorrect, I keep feeling incompetent at Work, which makes me feel 'stupid, lacking competence'. These feelings have persisted for the past few weeks, especially evident when handling complex technical problems, accompanied by Anxiety and affected sleep and appetite.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this sense of incompetence has affected my Work performance and overall physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: During a technical support call, gave a client incorrect computer repair advice, and the problem was believed to have worsened. In the weeks after the event, repeatedly replaying the mistake, Reinforcing Self-doubt; encountering complex technical problems leads to quickly falling into the cognition 'I am not good enough / incompetent', Decreased work efficiency, more mistakes, Anxiety intensified affecting sleep and appetite, while worrying about being judged by colleagues leads to Withdrawal and Relationship tension. During this time tried improving skills through online courses, but Self-doubt persists.

core_beliefs: I am not competent for this Work

special_situations.event: Once, after providing a client with computer repair advice, the client's problem was considered to have become worse
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, it equals I am not smart enough and also not competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes, doubles study through online classes to 'make up' and try to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am stupid, I am not suited for this job

special_situations.event: Encountering complex technical problems at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot solve complex problems immediately, it proves I have no ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Slowing down, repeatedly confirming, delaying decisions to reduce the risk of errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will definitely fail again; I cannot handle it

special_situations.event: Interacting with colleagues, worried they will see my struggles at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If colleagues see my inadequacies, they will look down on me/negate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication with colleagues, keeping distance to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am bad

special_situations.event: Recalls past experiences of successfully handling complex problems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only sustained and perfect performance can prove ability; occasional success does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or downplaying successful experiences, avoiding using them as evidence of ability

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent and capable, gaining others' affirmation and trust
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being evaluated as incompetent, belittled or humiliated
defense_goal: Avoiding exposure of inadequacies by Keeping distance from coworkers
Controlling mistakes and relieving Anxiety through self-criticism and excessive caution

object_relations.self_representation: A mistake-prone employee needing to constantly prove themselves
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are critical and will judge her abilities (clients / colleagues)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites me to review and acknowledge my successful experiences in handling complex problems
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Acknowledging success would seem like self-bragging and would ultimately be seen through as 'actually not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplays grades in a flat tone, attributes success to 'luck / coincidence / external causes', avoiding experiencing pride and a sense of ability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the mistakes in client incidents and their impact
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing mistakes entirely to one's own 'insufficient ability', ignoring situational and objective factors
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (like 'It is all my fault''I am too stupid'), taking full responsibility, negating any external influence.

manifestations: Withdrawing for fear of being judged by colleagues, reducing interaction
Having friends but struggling to talk about incompetence, feeling awkward to bring up
outcomes: Self-doubt at Work maintained and amplified

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Immediately Self-doubting when facing complex tasks, slowing down to aim for zero mistakes
Attributing success to luck, negating self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming colleagues will look down on/judge oneself
Therefore keeping distance from colleagues, reducing communication

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizing the perfect standard of 'cannot make mistakes, must solve problems in one go'
Measuring self-worth with perfect rules, Self-denying at the slightest mistake

exception_events.target_problem: When facing complex technical problems, the client usually immediately Self-doubts, slows down and is more prone to mistakes, ruminating repeatedly afterwards, Anxiety worsened.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a few situations of handling complex problems, he successfully solved them (rather than the usual failure anticipation and total negation), presenting results different from the dominant story.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different understanding—these successes themselves are evidence of competence; possible approach differences (reasonable inference)—more focused at the time, troubleshooting by process; situational differences—tasks better matching existing experience.

positive_force: Having had experience successfully handling complex problems (ability evidence exists)
Willing to seek help and try new methods (entering counseling, willing to do daily Reflection)
Having self-improvement motivation (already improved skills through online courses)
Has a few friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Self-labeling and overgeneralization, equating a single mistake with total incompetence
Predicting failure and mind-reading others' negative evaluations, leading to avoidance and hesitation
Rumination and self-blame maintaining Anxiety, interfering with sleep and impairing performance
Social withdrawal reducing support, further Reinforcing sense of incompetence and Sense of isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated rumination and Self-deprecation inner speech (like 'I am stupid/not competent'), accompanied by Anxiety and Difficulty falling asleep
antecedent: Recalling a mistake in a client incident
Encountering complex technical problems at work
When small mistakes or uncertainty occur during the day
target_behavior.core_reason: Views a single error as a total failure of their own ability (overgeneralization/catastrophizing), using self-blame to gain a 'sense of control' and trying to prevent making the same mistake again
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the Anxiety of failure and being evaluated, reducing uncertainty through Self-monitoring
target_behavior.consequence: Heightened Anxiety, Sleep impaired, Decreased work efficiency and more prone to repeat mistakes

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (Keeping distance from coworkers, reducing communication and help-seeking)
antecedent: Worrying colleagues will see one's struggles or mistakes
When anticipating being judged or looked down upon
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and personalization tendencies, believing others will evaluate oneself negatively and attributing problems to oneself
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Team Relationship tension, Available support decreasing, Decreased efficiency in problem solving, further Reinforcing Self-doubt
